notes.message: Adjacent-pixel noise measured 0.037 (color noise not detected); inverting the AE Noise calibration curve gives amount 18, monochrome. Grain is stochastic, expect a few units of slack.

The joint tone fit places the vignette at -1.06. The raw corner/center ratio alone suggested -1.56, but grain clipping, levels crush and glow bloom bias that reading; the fit reconciles it with the histogram. Negative darkens the edges.

The quantile curve also fits a Levels remap of input [0.080, 0.920] to output [0.040, 0.960]. Output fades (black lift / white ceiling) and input contrast show up here; grain smears the extremes, so check the Levels histogram in AE.

Mid-tone channel balance (region fixed by the reference, so split toning does not leak in) places temperature at -15 and tint at -4 (grid refined continuously, expect +-5). Saturation is divided out first.
Mid-tone chroma is corrected for white-balance chroma gain and the levels/exposure slope, then inverted through the saturation calibration curve: amount -67.

Strength and tone saturation trade off (drift = strength x tone distance), so this is the least determined aspect — treat the colors as starting points.
